thread:
drew_sales: Heads up - request from Meridian Bank (regulated/private). They want a one-off onboarding credit + delayed first invoice date to accommodate their procurement timeline. Deal: 12mo dedicated commit ~$410k ARR + managed support. Sales asking for $20k credit and move invoice date by 30 days. Approvals?

aisha: We need PS SOW, hours, and revenue impact of delaying invoice. Prefer credits capped and avoid shifting invoice if it impacts cash.

drew_sales: SOW in Deal Desk. PS ~300 hours (~$38k cost). Customer pays $14k PS; gap = $24k. They request $20k credit and invoice start delayed 30 days to align with budget.

marta_cs: CS can support rotations. Concern: delaying invoice also delays the start of support SLAs. Need explicit acceptance signoff in SOW to avoid disputes.neha_revops: RevOps: we can post one-time credit and change invoice date, but need AR to approve timeline. Also tagging tax for potential impact. We require GL mapping and ledger note.

neha_legal: Legal: addendum should capture credit amount, invoice shift, acceptance criteria, and 90-day clawback if they churn. For invoice shift we need a clause stating service starts on original timeline irrespective of billing, or vice versa per agreed terms.

apaul_cfo: From finance: ok to approve up to $15k one-time credit if we keep invoice dates firm (no delay). If Sales insists on invoice deferral, escalate to me for review of cash timing. Also require RevOps ledger entries and clawback.

drew_sales: Customer insists on both. If finance holds to $15k, suggest offering $15k credit + $5k PS discount (non-credit) so revenue recognition stays clear. They prefer credit but may accept PS discount.

aisha: Approve conditionally: $15k one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice + option to reduce PS fees by $5k (booked as PS revenue reduction), subject to RevOps entry, Legal addendum with 90-day clawback, and AR signoff for invoice shift if they still want it. If AR denies deferral, keep original invoice date.

drew_sales: Marking "conditional approval" and will present option to customer. I'll update Deal Desk and tag AR.

billing-bot: NOTE: Pending AR decision on invoice deferral. If deferral approved, update billing schedule.
